ATTACHMENT 1

Resource – Assignment Details:

Number of Resources required 1 Category 1- General Auditor 2 -Technical Auditor 3 - IT Auditor Category 1- General Auditor Dates Required Fieldwork phase – 11 May to 5 June 2025 No. of Working Days 20 Days Location Doha HSE – type of HSE Office based and Site Safety. Data Confidentiality – list any specific requirements Contractor shall not discuss or share any information related to the assignment and obtained during the Audit with any other person outside of the Company Audit Team. Scope of Services: To participate as an Auditor in the Company Internal Audit Team to evaluate and assess the Management of Privatized Companies process including the following sub processes: Corporate Governance Financial Consolidation and Reporting Management Reporting Compliance Management Public and Investor Relations Data and Records Management Cost Allocation Services required: Perform audit work in accordance with Company internal auditing standards and IIA Standards. Review, understand and execute the audit program to meet the audit objectives.

Document the audit testing results in a timely manner, with high quality and adequate working papers (using templates provided). Audit findings/observations to be well documented in Audit Memos with adequate supporting documentation. Discuss and agree the potential observations / gaps identified with the Lead Auditor on a timely basis. Discuss and agree with the auditee/client the agreed observations / gaps Document Audit Memos (within 2 days from their identification and agreement) and have them approved by the Lead Auditor. Audit Areas to be covered The relevant qualification and experience are required to cover the following audit scope areas: Financial Reporting Financial Consolidation Management Reporting Cost allocation



ATTACHMENT 2

Resource - Required skills:

Skill / Competence Area Specification Input by Service Provider [Please note: Simple Yes or No responses are not sufficient] Mandatory / Preferred / Desirable Minimum years of experience 5 years in auditing experience. M University Qualifications Mandatory - A bachelor’s degree M University Qualifications Preferable – A bachelor’s degree in finance M Professional Qualifications Preferable - Auditing certification is beneficial. P Professional Qualifications Desirable - Valid membership of a relevant professional body (e.g. The Institute of Internal Auditors) D Include	a list	of	relevant	courses attended. Experience Areas Prior experience in Finance Audit in the Energy Sector or Banking sector. P The relevant qualification and experience are required to cover the following audit scope areas: Financial Reporting Financial Consolidation Management Reporting Cost allocation Behavioral Good judgment and analytical skills (big picture) Please provide examples. M

Behavioral Strong organizational skills (scheduling meetings, adequate and timely working papers). Please elaborate / provide examples. M Behavioral Ability to work independently with minimum instructions and supervision from the Lead Auditor. Has (s)he led many assignments before? Size of assignments that were led. M Competence Very good expertise in Data Analytics techniques. Please	provide	details/examples	of expertise. P Competence Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel Provide examples in support of response. P Competence Good knowledge and use of SAP ERP system P Communication Strong written and oral communication skills (in English). This includes the ability to prepare high quality Audit Memos with recommendations. Provide examples of types of reports prepared. M Communication Excellent interpersonal and interviewing skills, including the ability to interact with all levels of management and employees. Provide examples of levels of management and employees that have been interacted with in the past. M

Location Is the resource based in Qatar or outside? P
